QuestInfo.name: The Special Ink
QuestInfo.0: You want to restore the #t4220151# that the Black Wings gave to #p2090004#. The one person in #b#m250000000##k who is capable of doing the restoration is #b#p2091008# the painter#k.
QuestInfo.1: #p2091008# states that to restore the #t4220151#, one must make a #b#t4032342##k and pour it all over the Scroll. He then asks you to bring the materials necessary to make the ink, so he can make some for you.\n
QuestInfo.2: You handed #p2091008# the materials and received #t4032342# in return. You should now open the #t4220151# and pour the #t4032342# over it.

0.0: What's going on? What? You're asking me if this #t4220151# can be restored? Let me see... Hmm. How in the world did you manage to boil the #t4220151#? Only a fool like #p2090004# would do that. Good thing it's made with such high quality paper.
0.1: Well, restoring the #t4220151# is not impossible. As long as I have some special ink, I'll be able to restore it. I can make the #t4032342# myself, so all you'll need to do is get me the materials needed for me to make one. I also charge a small fee, of course.

1.0: Wow, you brought all the materials I've asked you for. Now please hand me the items along with the required fee.

yes.0: Okay, here are 8 batches of #t4032342#. Now open up the #t4220151# and spray #t4032342# all over the scroll to restore the content. If you happen to lose the #t4032342#, then I'll make you more, so just let me know.

item.0: You still don't have the #t4032342#'s ingredients? Alright, one more time. Get #b25 #t4000588#s#k, #b25 #t4000589#s#k, and #b50 #t4000590#s#k. Of course, don't forget the #b50,000 Meso#k fee, either.
